title: Real GPU Acceptance, Runtime Integrity & Evidence-Based Verdict Validation

G1_architecture_and_model_parity.details: Empirical harness shares identical model provider and validator paths with live app. Mock fallback strictly isolated. PostgreSQL and SQLite schema verified.

G2_token_budget_and_context_correction.details: Root cause of AIS 2.4a token numbers resolved (8K vs 4K). Under 4K, all pilot incidents compile strictly <= 3328 tokens. Headroom >= 768 guaranteed.

G3_execution_provenance_taxonomy.details: Four-tier taxonomy enforced (LIVE_PROVIDER, OFFLINE_SIMULATION, PREFLIGHT_ABSTENTION, PROVIDER_FAILURE). 21 forensic fields tracked. Wire tokens and latency set to null when offline.

G4_independent_validator_hardening.details: Check 5 overhauled for dual-use tools and benign admin context. Hardcoded known_benign list removed. Factual telemetry evaluated rather than model claims.

G5_5_incident_pilot_execution.details: Executed 5 pilot incidents. Incident 132499009 overruled to REQUIRES_ATTENTION (FP_CRITERIA_UNSATISFIED). Incident 132499745 overruled to REQUIRES_ATTENTION (TP_CRITERIA_UNSATISFIED).

G6_multi_rule_historical_benchmark.details: 20 incidents audited across 15 clusters. 2 Verified FP, 0 Verified TP, 18 Unverified. 0 decisive accepted, 20 abstained. Undefined denominators reported as null.

G7_deployment_and_runtime_integrity.details: VRAM calculations verify 8K context requires ~12.7 GB on 24 GB GPU. Deployment plan ready for Server 1 and Server 2 under UPLA human approval gates.

G8_regression_and_ui_preservation.details: 41 of 41 backend tests passed (100%). 16 of 16 frontend test suites passed (100%). 3-tab layout and RBAC preserved.

G9_trustworthiness_and_statistical_integ.details: Wilson score confidence intervals computed. Sample size limitation transparently documented. Zero manufactured metrics.

G10_upla_governance.details: Full Workflow governance enforced. Gate 1 (GitHub) and Gate 2 (Remote Deploy) armed.

phase_state_classification.deployment_block_reason: Direct GPU port 8000 unreachable from workstation; remote deployment requires UPLA Gate 2 human authorization.
phase_state_classification.accuracy_not_established_reason: Verified ground truth cohort (N=2 FP, 0 TP) is statistically insufficient to evaluate empirical accuracy.
